title: Add a generic content-addressed application package and installer
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of package_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: The production mainframe-env-application crate is generic: its public manifest covers source, resource, program, data, profile, and migration entries without CardDemo names or behavior.
Manifest identity is a canonical length-delimited SHA-256 over contract, application/version/target, ordered entries, kinds, content identities, sizes, and dependencies.
Every blob is content-verified before state mutation; stage is explicitly not-ready, commit atomically marks ready, and identical install or restart returns the same record.
Missing cohorts/blobs, corrupt content, duplicate paths, orphan dependencies, incompatible product versions, and conflicting identities fail closed without creating a ready record.
The owned CardDemo inventory maps six cohort identities to the generic manifest and self-checks the exact package identity.

commands.result: atomic/idempotent and fail-closed installer tests passed
exact owned package inventory and generic install receipt passed
